brief: An evidence-led business investigator for Nepalese SMEs. The mark should feel clear, capable, calm and trustworthy in a working dashboard.
criteria: An identifiable S, readable at 16 px, one-color geometry, strong on navy and light surfaces, with Figtree typography.

concepts.name: Signal S
concepts.idea: Two evidence paths resolve into one S.
rationale: Opposing curves create a compact initial with a continuous flow.
Wide internal spaces survive small interface sizes.
Teal identifies actions; lime carries the mark on navy.

recommendation: Signal S was selected by the user and refined after monochrome and small-size review.
next_steps: Use the supplied SVG masters and local Figtree font.
Keep clear space and minimum sizes from the usage guide.
